conversations.content: Why does the sky look blue?
Air molecules scatter short blue wavelengths more strongly than red wavelengths. Scattered sunlight reaches our eyes from many directions, so a clear daytime sky usually appears blue.
A seed absorbs water and activates its stored nutrients. Roots grow down to collect water and minerals. A shoot grows toward light, and new leaves begin making sugars through photosynthesis.
Ice absorbs heat from warmer surroundings. Its water molecules gain enough energy to move out of their fixed arrangement. The solid becomes liquid while remaining the same substance.
How can I test whether seventeen is prime?
Check divisibility by prime numbers no greater than its square root. Seventeen is not divisible by two or three. Since its square root is less than five, seventeen is prime.
